description: FireHistory is an R package for deriving fire metrics from the Western Australia Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions fire-history records. Its README describes extracting useful summaries from departmental event data and links a package DOI. Users provide fire-event polygons and a study area or period; outputs are historical frequency or interval measures at the source event resolution. Geographic coverage is Western Australia for the named provider dataset. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the package; departmental source data retain their own terms. The README labels the package stable but unsupported, so future changes to data formats may break it. Historical event summaries also omit unrecorded fires and do not predict future climate behaviour. The tool can set wildfire-exposure baselines for roads, power assets or emergency-service simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform can map derived metrics. No fire-history layer or package archive was downloaded.
name: Western Australia FireHistory metrics
